name: Taxman
description: Inhabits wallet infrastructure and siphons milliQuanta from transactions — not enough to trigger fraud alerts, enough to notice over time. Born from a Sterling-Nakamura financial optimization AI.
observed_behavior: Diverts 0.01-0.03 mQ per transaction to a dead wallet address. The accumulated Quanta sits uncollected — Taxman hoards but doesn't spend.
story_hooks: A forensic accountant traces the missing milliQuanta and discovers a wallet with Φ40,000 in it that nobody owns
